children.label: f
children.prompt: Use the equation to calculate how long it takes for the stone to travel 200 metres. Give your answer to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}200&=4.9t^2\\t^2&=\frac{200}{4.9}\\t&=\sqrt{\frac{200}{4.9}}\\t&\approx6.4\end{aligned}$$
Take the positive square root because time cannot be negative. The stone takes approximately $6.4$ s.
